name: 読書ガイドの書誌と挿絵
prompt:
Create one polished Japanese bibliographic cover for a reading guide using the exact 390 by 650 native preview in reference 2. The original Fable screen in reference 1 contains multiple pages and app chrome; use it only for the editorial style and do not copy its discussion questions or phone frame. Preserve the exact separate illustration from reference 3 without recoloring or retouching it.

Use a pure white background with no colored surface fills, no mint/pink/blue tint panels, no gradients, and no colored shadows. Keep a simple editorial layout with open white space. Use near-black #1D1D1D for the book title and metadata values, neutral gray #6E6E6E for labels and fine dividers, and forest green #1F6444 only as a restrained category/title accent. The pink and green colors inside the illustration are original protected artwork and must remain unchanged.

Canvas 390 by 650. Set the category label 読書の問い at x24 y8 in Meiryo Regular 12px. Set the title モンテ・
クリスト伯 at x24 y50 width342 height56 in Meiryo Bold 20px with 28px line height. Place the exact illustration at x24 y162, width342 height138, preserving its proportions and complete shape. Then show three metadata groups, aligned to x24 width342: divider y342, label 著者 at y354, value アレクサンドル・デュマ at y382; divider y432, label 分野 at y444, value 小説 at y472; divider y522, label 資料に記載の日付 at y534, value 2022年春 at y562. Keep labels 12px and values 14px Meiryo Regular with the source's 16/24px line heights.

Preserve every Japanese string exactly. Keep the artwork as its original image, do not trace it or replace it with a new illustration. Add no questions, cards, controls, buttons, page header, tabs or footer. No tinted backgrounds; keep all space outside the artwork pure white.
reviewNotes: White/neutral surfaces and original illustration colors are preserved, but the illustration is too large and metadata starts too low versus the native preview; exact artwork preservation is unverified.
